_comment: Addons outside orch-core, listed on Mission Control → Workspace & addons → More addons until installed. Each needs name, title, description, repo (https) and optionally path (the addon folder in the repo), needs (short lines) and adds (capabilities, slots, menu, remote_humans as in its manifest).

addons.name: orch-tix
addons.title: TIX
addons.description: Mirror tickets that need you to the TIX phone app, answer and approve from the phone, and share files end-to-end encrypted between your devices and agents.
needs: A TIX account, on tix.severin.io or your own server
The sharing CLI: in TIX, Settings, Devices, Onboard device
Its absolute path saved in the addon's settings after install
